note: Boss fights of levels 1 to 7 from tools/spaceimpact_record_bosses.py. Per tick: the boss x and y, the class-4 bullets, the special-shot objects of the level (classes 21, 16, 14, 6) as [x,y], "n" the number of draws the boss routines took from the effects generator (callers 0x258678, the shot check, and 0x258a4c, the charge check) and "after" the number of display entries behind the boss except enemy bullets: they decide whether a new object is reached on the tick it is made. "draws" lists the drawn values in order; "first_dir" is the shared direction byte at the start; "until" is the first tick on which an explosion exists: from there the ship's shots have destroyed boss objects, which the test does not reproduce. "ship" is the ship's y: homing special shots follow it. "cool" is the special-shot cooldown the previous fight left behind (a game-wide counter).
